title: Melkote Manja
desc: Jaggesh, always in debt, finds unexpected allies among his debtors, who hilariously come to his rescue. Set in picturesque Melkote, it's a fun watch!

title: Maargan
desc: A serial killer targets women with a strange serum that turns their bodies black. Subsequently, a high-ranking police officer sets out to catch the culprit.

title: Ghost
desc: A gangster and his team hijack a prison in the city on a quest for justice. Eventually, they threaten to release all the criminals.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Nee Tata Naa Birla
desc: Ravi and Jaggu are friends who are good for nothing and get kicked out of their houses. However, chaos follows when a politician sends them on a mission to get a secret code from two girls.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kari Gooli
desc: After suffering mercilessly under the reign of a ruthless tycoon, the villagers find hope in a Jallikattu bull trainer, who locks horns with the tycoon.

title: Yaare Neenu Cheluve
desc: A woman loses her bag which contains important documents and a man ends up finding it. Later, he sends it to her along with a letter which begins a romantic exchange amongst them.
